status: Re-frozen on the 1,025-record corpus (vaine-dataset.train.jsonl + vaine-dataset.eval.jsonl), Phase 0.4c (2026-07-06). Supersedes v1 (induced from 228 raw topics). Facet values reordered to real corpus frequency; domain enum corrected (5 missing domains added); tone changed categorical -> open (138 distinct observed).
note: Each facet ships a detector for the gap metric. class_boundary is deterministic (length), independent of facets. Categorical values ordered by real corpus frequency.

facets.note: ordered by real corpus frequency; 'prompt' is the core Vaine artifact (rare in the public WildChat corpus but central in real Vaine usage) - retained. 'other' is a large catch-all. Dropped from v1: leaked domain-values (content_social, research) that the labeler mis-tagged as artifacts.

facets.detector: rewrite specifies who it is for

facets.note: v1 categorical -> v2 open: 138 distinct tone values observed in the corpus. Canonical top-list kept for normalization.

facets.detector: rewrite states length/format/limits, a word cap ('15 words'), 'compress', 'search internet first', or 'measure against <reference>'

facets.note: ordered by real corpus frequency; technical leads. The 9 target domains: startups, entrepreneurship, research, jobs, marketing, content_social, finance, business, technical. general/personal/real-estate/career are off-target diversity (small, retained per Option A).

facets.detector: rewrite states what a good result looks like
facets.note: sparse in the corpus; flywheel to populate

class_boundary: simple = input length <= 120 characters; complex = input length > 120 characters. VALIDATED on the 1,025 corpus (0.4c): simple n=506 median 64 (max 120), complex n=519 median 223 (min 121) - clean separation. Rationale (Jeremie, 2026-07-05): <=120 chars cannot carry enough detail to specify constraints, so it is simple; >120 provides detail, so it is complex. DETERMINISTIC - the Classifier is a length check, no ML model. Facets are tagged independently (descriptive); class is purely length.
fallback: if goal or artifact cannot be detected -> under-specified; route to review, do not train on it
